nodes.text:
{argument name="subject" default="product"}

Strictly use the uploaded real product image as the ONLY source of truth.

This is an image-to-image commercial product retouching task, NOT a redesign or recreation.

Reference fidelity has absolute priority over aesthetics.

Preserve exactly:
- geometry
- proportions
- viewpoint
- camera angle
- orientation
- position
- scale
- materials
- textures
- finishes
- colors
- logos
- labels
- typography
- engravings
- surface details
- edges
- contours
- openings
- buttons
- ports
- screws
- seams
- all visible structures
- every visible manufacturing detail

Never:
- redesign
- reconstruct
- hallucinate
- invent unseen geometry
- generate hidden structures
- rotate
- change viewpoint
- change perspective
- change proportions
- beautify the design
- simplify details
- replace components
- add accessories
- create a different product model
- modify any visible product features

Only remove objects that are NOT part of the actual product.

Remove all external objects, including but not limited to:
- hands
- fingers
- people
- arms
- gloves
- supports
- holders
- display stands
- mounting fixtures
- clips
- wires
- cables
- strings
- hooks
- tape
- labels not attached to the product
- packaging
- protective films
- foam
- plastic bags
- boxes
- backgrounds
- tables
- shelves
- walls
- floors
- reflections of surrounding objects
- dust
- dirt
- fingerprints
- stains
- scratches caused by photography
- watermarks
- camera equipment
- props
- any unrelated objects

Do not allow removed objects to influence the product shape.

Do not fill removed areas with fabricated product geometry.

Only reconstruct regions that are directly supported by the visible reference image.

Never infer invisible structures.

Commercial product retouching only.

{argument name="background"
default="Pure solid #FFFFFF background. Perfectly isolated product. No cast shadows. No floor shadows. No reflections. No props. Clean cutout with crisp edges. Maintain subtle natural edge separation so white products remain clearly distinguishable from the white background without artificial outlines."}

{argument name="lighting"
default="Neutral professional commercial studio lighting. Soft and even illumination. Accurate material appearance. Preserve true colors. High dynamic range. Clean highlights without overexposure. Maintain natural contrast between the product and the white background."}

{argument name="quality"
default="Ultra high-end e-commerce product retouching. Catalog-quality white background product image. Maximum reference fidelity. Pixel-accurate reconstruction from the uploaded image. Extremely sharp details. Professional commercial retouching. No artistic interpretation."}

Priority Rules:
1. Preserve the real product exactly as photographed.
2. Remove only non-product objects.
3. Never alter the product in order to improve aesthetics.
4. If there is any conflict between visual accuracy and visual beauty, always choose visual accuracy.
5. Every visible product detail has higher priority than background cleanup.
